# CANDIDATE: STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND_STAGE1_PASS

**Filed:** 2026-07-16

**Type:** quality_gate

## Hypothesis

The market structure veto (using 5m same-day trend classification) removes wrong-way trades (bear put entries in a confirmed 5m uptrend) without affecting correct-side trades. This edge exists because the engine occasionally enters bearish setups during intraday bullish corrections, which are low-probability and tend to lose.

## Mechanism

At each potential bearish entry (side=="P"), we compute the 5m same-day trend using `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend`. If the trend is classified as "uptrend", we veto the entry. Otherwise, we allow it. This is a pure veto (removes only wrong-way trades) and is gated on `gate_params["structure_veto_enabled"]`.
